method: Published site coordinates converted to WGS 84: the first row of the Main Injector TDR appendix "8 GeV Line Site Coordinates" (survey of beam line P8_GEV) is DUSAF x = 99511.38281 ft, y = 99309.84375 ft, the point where the line leaves the Booster. Conversion with the Fermilab Site Coordinate System of Beams-doc-1148 (origin A0 = 41°50′14.312704″ N, 88°15′41.143123″ W, false x = y = 100000 ft, +y at geodetic azimuth 38°16′48.01429″), as a rotated tangent plane on GRS80.
name: Booster extraction point (start of the 8 GeV transfer line)

summary.plain: The point on the Booster ring where the 8 GeV beam is sent off towards the Main Injector.
